title: Weighted fusion is quietly favouring one leg
concept: Min-max normalisation divides by the RANGE. Divide by the max and a leg whose floor is not zero gets compressed toward the top.
skill: You can spot a normalisation that is not scale-free by asking what happens to a leg whose minimum is not zero.
deeper: docs/30-learning/interview-prep/01-mathematical-foundations/reciprocal-rank-fusion.md -- why RRF avoids this whole class of bug by consuming ranks
